_meta.name: OFFICE iQ — Company + Tickets DUMMY TEMPLATE (rules-only, no real content)
_meta.purpose: Upload exactly this file (company + tickets already merged) via the admin Catalog toolbar's 'Add workspace' button, 'Company & tickets file (.json) *' picker (POST /api/admin/catalog/import, ADR 0009). This is the one required file for that flow — 'DSA problems file' and 'Quiz file' on the same modal are separate, optional uploads (see dsa-template.json / quiz-template.json). This whole `_meta` block is ignored on import (unknown top-level keys are stripped).
howToUse: 1. Fill in `company` — this becomes the catalog/workspace entry.
2. Replace the sample `tickets` entries with real ones — one ticket per simulation day, day 1..30, no duplicate days, at most 30 total.
3. Delete this `_meta` block (optional — it's stripped automatically) and upload as the 'Company & tickets file'.

4. Optionally also pick a separate DSA and/or quiz file in the same modal (dsa-template.json / quiz-template.json) — they get merged onto this same import automatically, no need to combine them into this file too.
_meta.validationOrder: The whole bundle is normalized BEFORE anything is written to the database. An invalid file returns 422 with a `details` array listing every problem found — no partial/orphan data is ever created. Re-uploading the same `slug` later is a 409 (no upsert) — pick a slug you're sure is new.

hardLimits.tickets: 1 to 30 items, one per simulation day (1..30), each day used at most once

notes: `company.techStack` is a free-form object — the keys shown below are just the common ones, not a fixed schema. Add, remove, or rename keys freely (e.g. `messaging`, `observability`) — the workspace UI renders every key you set.

`company.category` accepts either an array (a workspace can carry more than one, e.g. ["JAVA", "REACT"] — ADR 0019) or a single string (back-compat). It's optional; omit it entirely for an uncategorized entry rather than sending an empty array (rejected).
`company.slug` must be lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only, and must not already exist in the catalog.

`tickets[].day` is optional per item — if omitted, the item's position in the array (1st = day 1, 2nd = day 2, ...) is used instead. Prefer setting it explicitly so re-ordering the array can't silently change days.
`tickets[].ticketId` is optional — if omitted one is generated from the domain + day.
Only 3 sample tickets are shown to keep this template short — copy an object to add more, up to the 30 hard limit.

company.name: <COMPANY_OR_PROJECT_DISPLAY_NAME>
category: <FULLSTACK | JAVA | REACT | JAVASCRIPT | TYPESCRIPT | REACT_NATIVE | AI_ML>
company.description: <longer description of the simulated codebase/product, max 4000 chars>
company.domainDetails: <domain-specific context a candidate needs, max 2000 chars>

tickets.title: <short ticket title, max 200 chars>
tickets.description: <full ticket description a candidate reads before starting, max 4000 chars>

tickets.title: <example: a real feature/bug/security ticket>
tickets.description: <describe the concrete task, the file(s)/area involved, and how it's verified>
